title: ConceptNet and Commonsense Question Answering
summary: This community centers on the application of ConceptNet, an external commonsense knowledge graph, to the task of Commonsense Question Answering (CSQA). ConceptNet was proposed by H Liu and P Singh and published in the BT technology journal. The system utilizes this graph to retrieve relevant knowledge for multiple-choice questions that require commonsense reasoning.
key_findings: Commonsense Question Answering (CSQA) is distinguished from Knowledge Base Question Answering by its primary format of multiple-choice questions.
CSQA systems utilize external commonsense knowledge graphs, specifically ConceptNet, to find relevant knowledge pertaining to questions and answer options.
ConceptNet was proposed by authors H Liu and P Singh.
The ConceptNet paper was published in the BT technology journal in 2004.
The objective of using ConceptNet in CSQA is to engage in appropriate reasoning to derive the correct answer from the provided options.
